question: Clement Attlee who later became Prime Minister of Britain came to India as a member of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Simon Commission__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Clement Attlee who later became Prime Minister of Britain came to India as a member of Simon Commission.
 
• The British government appointed the Simon Commission to review the Government of India Act 1919 in the year 1927.
 
• The Simon commission arrived in India in 1928.
 
• It was formed to study constitutional reforms and make recommendations to the government in India.
 
• Simon commission was an all- commission without any Indian members.
 
• The commission consisted of seven Englishman and sir John Simon was its chairman.
 
• It was formed on 26th November 1927.
 
• Simon commission arrived in India on 3rd February 1928.
 
• The Madras session of the congress passed a resolution to boycott the Simon Commission.
 
• Simon commission submitted its reports on 27th May 1930.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 The Cabinet Mission came to India in 1946 to discuss the transfer of power from British rule to Indian leadership.
 
 

 Option 2
 The Simon Commission was a group of British Members of Parliament that came to India in 1928 to study constitutional reform.
 
 

 Option 3
 The Wavell Plan was a proposal by the then Viceroy of India, Lord Wavell, in 1945 to involve Indian leaders in the governance of India.
 
 

 Option 4
 The Cripps Mission was an attempt in 1942 by the British government to secure Indian cooperation during World War II.
